title: Long weekends for state government employees by US state, 2027
definition: A long weekend is a run of at least three consecutive days off that includes a Saturday and/or Sunday and at least one weekday on which state offices close for a paid holiday. A bridge day is one working weekday between two days off; taking it as vacation gives a long weekend of four days or more. Floating, half, local and Confederate-era days are not used. New Year's Day of the next year, observed on December 31, is a closure day of this year here (it counts for the next year in the paid-holiday ranking).
